metrics.method: Full history 2026-04-30 to 2026-08-28 (1006 messages, 15 service events). client_questions_total = grep count of Kirsten (amber Haze) messages containing '?' (109). unanswered_over_24h = manual read of substantive client questions with no on-topic answer from our side within 24h or ever: bio-link safety (May 13), proof screenshots of flagged posts/paid ads (Jun 4), links to the two new IG pages (Jun 4, answered Jun 16), whether she should run Meta ads on her main IG (Jun 4), Wesley 'small surprise' idea (Jun 9, re-asked Jun 22), Snapchat usage guidance (Jul 3, ~28h), IG page names (Jul 14), trial-reels/35-followers complaint (Jul 21, substantive answer Aug 1), Meta higher-up rep cost split (Aug 2, still open at 26 days), anything needed from her for the Monday switch (Aug 2, still open at 26 days), whether the remaining IG warnings can be cleared and when (Aug 14/19, still open at 14 days). Excludes 12 bare nudges ('?', '??', 'Hey?', 'Hello anyone going to reply?') and excludes one 14-day-late answer that came from smurf(offline), who clients.yaml classes as client-side. max_team_silence_days = longest gap between consecutive messages from team.yaml aliases = 4.59d (Michelle 2026-06-16 00:20 -> Stephski 2026-06-20 14:25); the live gap at analysis time is 2.7d (Michelle 2026-08-25 17:49) and the last non-templated outbound was 6d ago (Mayson 2026-08-22 04:15). promises = explicit commitments by team.yaml senders, near-duplicates merged (e.g. the May 21 paid-push and rapid-growth statements counted once); kept = evidenced as delivered in-chat, lapsed = contradicted, silently dropped, or never confirmed back to her. The Wesley Aug 11/14 sends, the Aug 20/21 fan counter-offers and the Aug 21 Facebook campaign numbers are counted lapsed because there is zero confirmation in the chat.
